notes.title: A Sceptic's Guide to Magic Set To Release on August 16Th (Wishlist/Follow Today)
notes.notes:
[h1] "A Sceptic's Guide to Magic" will be released on Friday 16th August![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066823/fa1127cbebb54d4860a172a63ac75aae6465c816.png[/img]

Birmingham, England: 1993. A shocking ritual murder compels a world-weary forensic investigator to discover a hidden realm of witchcraft, gods and demons. Follow clues and use magic to solve the case, with moral choices leading to multiple possible endings. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066823/e9f1b63c4f415adf969cb761265a4f076faebbe3.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.4 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Optional mouse support has been added. The game can still be played with keyboard or gamepad.
[*] A few new pieces of atmospheric music will accompany your exploration of the house and interview with the inspector.
[*] The default window size has been increased, which should also offer a better resolution when playing in full screen.
[*] Some minor tweaks and improvements to graphics.
[/list]

Please let us know if you experience any problems with this update.

notes.title: Version 1.2 - Achievements!
notes.notes:
- Steam achievements have been added, 17 in total.
- You can now choose to skip the intro.
- There is now an additional way to plant evidence against your father.
- Fixed a bug caused by trying to cancel while selecting a murder weapon.
- Some cosmetic improvements to the title screen and sound effects.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Changes/Fixes
notes.notes:
- Being extremely lecherous towards the maid no longer causes the game to freeze.
- No more climbing the walls in your parents' bedroom!
- There is now a warning when approaching the murder room that there is no turning back should you choose to enter.
- Some guidance has been added to the start of the game about how to access the inventory.
- You can no longer access the inventory and attempt to plant evidence after committing the murder. Evidence must be planted before the deed is done.
- Fixed a bug where the game failed to progress if you exit the murder room while the maid is approaching the door.
